meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 它按 Dieter Rams 十条原则逐条给设计打 0–3 分并附证据,判定是新设计、改进还是重做,然后在 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录里产出范围、证据、评分表、结论和一条可直接跑的 /make-plan 提示词。
howto.when: 当你说“audit this design”“design review”“design audit”等关键词,或想要一次能接上计划的设计批评时接管。常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改不在它范围内。

say.text: 帮我审计这个设计,按 Rams 十条原则打分
say.note: 产出证据、评分表和结论

say.text: 检查这个 UI 是否符合 Rams 原则
say.note: 写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录

say.text: 把这次审计结论做成 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 给出可直接复制的交接提示词

howto.what_en: It scores a design 0–3 against Dieter Rams' ten principles with cited evidence, gives a NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN verdict, and writes a DESIGN-IS-<date>/ folder with scope, evidence, scorecard, verdict, and a /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “audit this design”, “design review” or “design audit”, or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan. Routine UI code reviews and pure copy edits are out of scope.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles
say_en.note: Writes scored evidence and a verdict

say_en.text: Turn this audit into a /make-plan prompt
